name: Kalra & Barr Implicit Surface Intersection
definition: A robust and mathematically sound ray-intersection algorithm for implicit surfaces that is guaranteed to numerically find the nearest intersection of the surface with a ray, and is guaranteed not to miss fine features of the surface.
summary: Kalra & Barr Implicit Surface Intersection is a robust algorithm that guarantees finding the nearest ray intersection with LG-implicit surfaces without missing fine details, distinguishing itself by ensuring numerical convergence without fine-tuning.
